scope: All9original adjacent model edges; metrics selected from existing independently audited score CSVs; no rescoring or new model training.

population.selection_rule: One fixed permutation of sorted original training UIDs, identical to continuous-chain studies; retain every chosen-user request and its complete candidate set.

metric: positive-request macro observed-positive NDCG@10; Recall@10 secondary
uncertainty: Paired UID-cluster bootstrap,2000 draws seed17; nominal intervals, no multiplicity adjustment.

source_consistency_checks.chosen_request_join: exact one_to_one complete-user day; actual positive/candidate/history counts match

limitations: Both cohorts were already contained in the original full30000 evaluation; this is a fixed-cohort diagnostic, not newly unseen confirmation.
The same fixed users recur across edges and share models; intervals are per edge, not independent experiments.
No population, window, training plan, chain acceptance or background process was changed.
Time slices are reported in full and do not replace full-day evaluation.
